user.title: Add Apple TV
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Apple TV.

data_description.host: The IPv4 address of the Apple TV, for example 192.168.1.20.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Apple TV
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? The Apple TV will show PIN codes for pairing.

pair_with_pin.title: Pair {protocol}
pair_with_pin.description: Enter the PIN code that {name} shows on the TV to pair {protocol}.

pair_no_pin.title: Pair {protocol}
pair_no_pin.description: Enter the PIN code {pin} on {name} to pair {protocol}, then select Submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts the stored credentials. Confirm its IP address to pair it again.

error.cannot_connect: No Apple TV answered at this IP address.
error.invalid_pin: Wrong PIN code. Check the code shown on the TV and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Apple TV is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This Apple TV is already being set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Apple TV answered at the discovered address.
abort.reauth_successful: The Apple TV was paired again.
abort.wrong_device: A different Apple TV answered at this IP address.

data_description.name: Name of the Apple TV device in Home Assistant.
